[  edit  ]
The Ray  SOP  is used to project one surface onto another. Rays are projected from each point of the input geometry in the direction of its normal. This can be used to drape clothes over surfaces, shrink-wrap one object with another, and other similar effects.

re for an informative workshop. POPs create and modify 3D data, replacing the older SOPs (Surface Operators) with enhanced performance and flexibility. ## 1. What are POPs? - **Definition**: POPs (Point Operators) are a family of operators in TouchDesigner that run on the GPU, leveraging high parallelism to create and manipulate 3D data efficiently. - **Purpose**: They generate and modify points, primitives, and attributes for rendering (via Render TOP) or output to external devices like LED arrays or lasers. - **Significance**: POPs replace SOPs with GPU acceleration, memory optimization, and integration with modern workflows (e.g., USD, FBX). ## 2. Core Components ### Points - Every POP contains a set of points with attributes. - **Key Attribute**: `P` (Position), a 3D vector (float3) defining a point’s location. - **Other Attributes**: Include `Color` (float4: red, green, blue, alpha), `Normal (N)` (float3), and user-defined attributes. ### Primitives - **Types**: - **Point**: 1 p
